run_panoptic_evaluation_cli: run panoptic evaluation from CLI by passing gt-json, gt-dir, pred-json, and pred-dir arguments
create_COCOPanopticEvaluator: create a COCOPanopticEvaluator instance with a dataset name and optional output directory for saving results
process_panoptic_predictions: process model inputs and outputs to convert panoptic segmentation predictions into PNG images and segment info
evaluate_panoptic_quality: evaluate panoptic quality metrics including PQ, SQ, and RQ for things and stuff categories
convert_category_id: convert contiguous category IDs to dataset IDs for thing and stuff segments in panoptic predictions
